quests.title: Switch-On Night
quests.summary: The Blackpool Illuminations need fuses, bulbs and a celebrity before tonight's switch-on.

steps.text: Win the spare fuses from Tram Driver Alf at the tram stop on the promenade.
Collect Doreen's crate of spare bulbs from the keeper at the end of Southport Pier.
Find a celebrity stand-in: Uncle Norman at the Winter Gardens knows everyone.
Throw the switch on the promenade stage by the Tower, after dusk.

quests.reward: A Golden Bulb, five sticks of rock, two chippy teas and England's thanks.

quests.title: Strictly Tower Ballroom
quests.summary: Dance two-by-two against the unbeaten Twinkletoes in the Tower Ballroom.

steps.text: Ask the Wurlitzer organist for a tune to dance to.
Win the Creature Dance Contest, a double battle against the Twinkletoes.

quests.reward: Three sticks of rock and a Rowan Sprig.

quests.title: Bramble's Day Out
quests.summary: Bramble the beach donkey has slipped her halter and wandered off down the coast.

steps.text: Ask along the beach: the ice-cream seller by Central Pier sees everything.
Follow Bramble south down the coast. Donkeys love a vegetable patch.
Tell Jack on Blackpool beach that Bramble's on her way home.

quests.reward: A Lucky Horseshoe (one of Bramble's) and two sticks of rock.

quests.title: Reds in the Pines
quests.summary: Help the National Trust ranger survey Formby's red squirrels and natterjack toads.

steps.text: Count four red squirrels in the clearings of Formby's pinewoods.
Catch a natterjack toad in the warm dune slack west of the pines.
Report back to Ranger Hughes in the pinewoods.

quests.reward: An Oak Acorn charm and two pots of potted shrimps.

quests.title: A Stick of Rock
quests.summary: The rock factory is short-handed in switch-on week. Earn an apron.

steps.text: Beat Apprentice Liam in a rock-pulling battle.
Learn how the letters get inside the rock from Maureen.

quests.reward: Six sticks of rock and two Eccles cakes.
